verses.restored: MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O YHWH.

familiar.text: MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.

modern.text: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!

original.text: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָֽׁה

verses.restored: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

familiar.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

modern.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

original.text: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי

verses.restored: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

familiar.text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

modern.text: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.

original.text: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח

verses.restored: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

familiar.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

modern.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”

original.text: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O YHWH, make no tarrying.

familiar.text: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

modern.text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּאַחַֽר
